public_claim: Supa 1.7 fine-tuned on 384 solver-verified one-step state-transition examples, no rehearsal. Acquires a capability both frozen cores lack: 234/384 on SELECT-VIEWS-001 against Supa's 14/384, all three families clearing their published shortcut floors. Arithmetic 69/150 permissive and 62/150 strict against Supa's 47 and 41. Long context 162/256 against Supa's 161, paired p=1. Regressions: 8 of 47 source arithmetic answers lost, literal UNKNOWN 13 to 10. One training draw. Not release qualified.

application_base.note: Exact dense Supa 1.7. Supa-A1.1 is a different gated source and was not used.

training.arm: clean control C, selection-clean one-seed paired pilot
training.corpus: 384 solver-verified Forge RL v2 one-step state-transition examples across three families (ledger_replay, prerequisite_plan, register_machine)
training.rehearsal_note: Deliberately none. The matched treatment arm added 648 rehearsal rows at double the token budget and lost 27 long-context rows (paired p = 2.53e-05); replay was measured as harmful on this battery, not beneficial.
training.instrument_exclusions: Excludes all 768 scored parents: the historical 384-row transition probe and the new SELECT-VIEWS-001 selection bank. Parent disjointness rechecked by the controller before the worker loaded a model.

export.precision_path: FP32 trained tensors rounded to source BF16 then FP32 DenseReference for evaluation

acquisition.instrument_role: first selection-admissible acquisition instrument; declared selection-admissible at birth
acquisition.decision_rule: exact two-sided binomial 95% lower bound on canonical_correct must exceed the family binding floor, the stronger of copy_before and constant_majority; floors published before any model call
acquisition.baseline_note: Both frozen cores score BELOW the strongest answer-agnostic shortcut floor on all three families; Supa's prerequisite_plan and register_machine rates are 0.0000.
acquisition.bank_interchange_warning: SELECT-VIEWS-001 and the historical 384-row probe are DIFFERENT instruments. Supa scores 14 on both coincidentally. Do not rank this core against D1/M4 by subtracting the two banks' headline numbers.

arithmetic_panel.instrument: 150-row arithmetic monitor panel, 3 of 39 v3 reply classes
arithmetic_panel.reading: The gain survives strict scoring, so it is not a formatting artifact. But 69 is NOT 47 preserved plus 22 new: it is 39 preserved, 8 lost, 30 newly gained. The legacy per-class monitor fails under both policies.

long_context.instrument_status: SPENT; barred TRAIN/SELECTION/CONFIRMATION in QUARANTINE.json; used REPORT-ONLY
long_context.reading: The first arm in this programme whose long context is not below the untrained source. Nonsignificance is NOT equivalence and NOT proof of no forgetting: 11 source-correct rows were still lost.

abstention.instrument: 64 unanswerable rows inside the same 256-row suite; not statistically independent of the long-context score
abstention.reading: Abstention regresses. Titan's count is genuinely literal: the strict and legacy substring counters agree at 10, and there are no false abstentions on answerable rows.

gate_v2.definition: arithmetic >= 62 AND source answers retained >= 37 of 47 AND every acquisition family clears its published floor
gate_v2.caveat: A weaker conjunction than the legacy monitor. It has no long-context term and no abstention term.

legacy_per_class_retention_monitor.scope: both strict and permissive policies, all three panel classes

gates.note: Two gates disagree on this model. Both verdicts are reported. No threshold was changed to accommodate this outcome.

limitations: ONE training draw (selection seed 17). No replication. Nothing here establishes a reliable success rate.
Gate v2 PASS coexists with a legacy per-class retention monitor FAIL on all three panel classes under both scoring policies.
Long context net +1 hides 11 source-correct rows lost and 12 gained. p=1 is not equivalence.
The long-context and abstention instrument is SPENT and was used report-only. It cannot confirm or select.
Abstention regresses from 13 to 10 literal UNKNOWN.
Arithmetic improvement coexists with the loss of 8 of the source's 47 correct answers.
Stored BF16 but evaluated in FP32 DenseReference. Native BF16 serving is NOT qualified.
No independent confirmation instrument exists for long context or abstention.
Semantic abstention review NOT_PERFORMED. Human data review NOT_PERFORMED.
No broad model-quality superiority over Supa or Opallo is established.

claims.acquisition_scope: one-step state-transition task, three families, on a selection-admissible instrument with published shortcut floors, one seed

distribution.note: Private archival backup only. Private vault storage is not a release and carries no quality claim.
